purpose: Measure the unchanged flat actor on the registered 5-degree uphill plus roughness instance; evaluate safe completion, drift, tracking, posture and slip before training.

runtime.gpu_timing_scope: Whole-device memory/utilization includes other users; no exclusive-device throughput inference.

preflight: Clean committed worktree and model submodule; original checkpoint and newly frozen input hashes match.
GPU0 memory.total - memory.used >=12288 MiB; existing compute processes are allowed and recorded.
Unused output directory; one episode, 120 s startup and 240 s total budgets, 10 s cleanup grace.

report_separately.condition_passed: Original 9 m + 50 stable-step acceptance, unchanged SafetyFilter and termination thresholds.
report_separately.diagnostic_evidence_complete: v2 per-step 17-body original-dtype predicate replay; independently checked p_COM=p_link+Rr and v_link=v_COM-omega cross Rr; pre-reset alignment; explicit root state; actual COM startup readback. Nonfinite reference state is unverifiable.
report_separately.gpu_resources: Before/after occupant snapshots; exact own-runtime process check after cleanup; whole-device sampled memory peak includes other users and cannot be attributed entirely to this run.

stop_rule: Stop after the one episode or any failure. Preserve the result and all diagnostics; do not retry, alter seeds/thresholds, move to another terrain, or initialize PPO.
limitations: One fixed combined terrain and initial-state seed; previous smooth-uphill failures and stair passes do not isolate roughness effects or establish a family success rate.
Safety completion and tracking quality are reported separately.
No PPO, policy updates, G3/G4 qualification or continuous-time boundary guarantee.
Whole-device GPU measurements include other jobs.
authorization_rule: Current user approval covers preparation and exactly one slope-plus-rough uphill episode; stop and report afterward.
known_validation_limitations: Initial related regression: 614 passed, one signal-resistant descendant cleanup test failed. Subsequent supervisor 64/64 and related regression 615/615 passed. Cause of the initial failure is unisolated; supervisor code unchanged; not claimed fixed.
